UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document storing authentication details, preferences, and Pro membership status.

uid.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID matching request.auth.uid

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL of the user

isPro.description: Whether the user has active Pro tier status

proPlan.description: Active Pro plan tier name or free tier identifier

totalConversions.description: Total count of completed file conversions

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of account profile creation

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of last profile update

ConversionHistory.title: ConversionHistory
ConversionHistory.description: Record of a completed file conversion performed by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier of the history item

userId.description: UID of the user who performed the conversion

fileName.description: Name of the converted output file

toolId.description: ID of the converter module used

originalSize.description: Size of original file in bytes

fileSize.description: Size of converted output file in bytes

PaymentRequest.title: PaymentRequest
PaymentRequest.description: Manual payment proof screenshot submission for Pro membership upgrade review.

id.description: Unique identifier of the payment request

userId.description: Firebase UID of user submitting payment proof

userEmail.description: Email address of the purchasing user

planId.description: Identifier of the chosen membership plan

planName.description: Readable name of the selected tier

transactionId.description: Bank / Wallet transaction or reference number

screenshotUrl.description: Storage download URL or URI of the receipt image

storagePath.description: Firebase storage path if stored in bucket

rejectionReason.description: Reason for denial if rejected by admin

approvedBy.description: Admin UID or email who processed the request

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last review update

/users/{userId}.description: Root collection storing private user profiles and Pro membership status.

/users/{userId}/history/{historyId}.description: Subcollection storing persistent file conversion history records for the owner.

/paymentRequests/{requestId}.description: Root collection of submitted payment proof screenshots for admin review and automatic Pro upgrade.
